key.name: warp-pointer
key.description: Arriving on workspace 1 puts the pointer at the center of the secondary screen; leaving it with the pointer still there brings it back to the center of the primary screen.

key.name: auto-share
key.summary: Windows opened on workspace 1 go to the secondary screen
key.description: While the mode is on, a window arriving on workspace 1 of the primary screen (new, or moved there) is sent to the secondary screen. Windows already there when the mode turns on are left alone.

key.name: share-window
key.summary: Share or take back the focused window
key.description: Sends the focused window to the secondary screen, or brings it back to the primary one. Not in the menu: change it with gsettings or dconf.

key.name: mute-notifications
key.description: Turn notification banners off while the presentation mode is on, and restore them after.

key.name: banners-muted
key.summary: Internal: banners muted by the extension
key.description: Set while the extension holds the notification banners off, so they are restored even after a crash.
